verses.1: To be destroyed by the sounds of a song.
verses.2: May God protect us and bless us, as His face shines upon us.
verses.3: To know in this land your ways, in all nations your salvation.
verses.4: May God bless all nations. May He bless all people.
verses.5: Let them rejoice and be glad, O nations! For nations will be judged from their sins, and peace will be brought to the earth.
verses.6: May God bless all nations. May He bless all peoples.
verses.7: This land has been given to us by Yebulah. May God, our God, bless us.
verses.8: May God bless us, and may all people in the world fear Him.
